show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/5sh7XC
show.description:
A forbidden wedding brews under the shadow of betrayal and threats.
Goons are summoned to shatter vows before they’re made.
A mother fights to protect her fragile child while ghosts of the past return.
In love, lies, and survival—no one’s fate is certain.
